# Subtitle fixtures

- `fansub-rich.ass`: original Sillage fictional dialogue, shaped around layered fansub
  dialogue, positioned panels, fading, intentional overlap, Japanese/French Unicode,
  commented editor notes, vector/mixed drawing, karaoke, movement and metadata.
  It is a regression fixture, not evidence of compatibility with every fansub.
- `upstream-aegisub-images.ass`: unmodified pysubs2
  `tests/data/subtitle_with_attached_images_aegisub.ass`, commit
  `ae3c520a8aa13130f36d84df02ce15a843bc9bdb`, generated by Aegisub 3.3.3;
  tests preservation of real opaque attachment sections. It contains encoded
  GitHub image examples from the upstream test suite. MIT copyright and permission
  notice are in `LICENSE-pysubs2.txt`. No fonts are included.

The richer behavioral fixture is original because shipping dialogue extracted from
an actual copyrighted episode is unnecessary. The independent upstream Aegisub
artifact checks a serializer hazard that simplified generated examples miss.
